semantic_review.reviewer: separate AI agent; not human gold panel

scope.not_reviewed: Full-scoring trials, all negative/extra selections, or complete task success.

interpretation: Keep all original gold and arithmetic scores unchanged. This review is post-run interpretation, not a replacement scoring rule.
Absence from the final selected set is not necessarily failure to discover the document.
Scope-sensitive does not mean gold is proven wrong or the answer is proven fully correct. It means strict necessary-evidence necessity is not unambiguous under the concise-response contract.
Do not turn this selected error review into semantic answer accuracy, a new adjusted recall, or a general discrimination claim.

native_tool_review.normalization: Only 24-hex synthetic memory IDs replaced for display; all shell structure, paths, search patterns and original expressions preserved; every replaced ID validated against the dataset.
native_tool_review.review_method: Agent inspected all semantic views, including complete shell expressions, not only keyword flags. Every original expression and invocation is linked to a category; scope exceptions additionally checked against returned output.
findings: Observed agent commands were local content reads/searches, path discovery, git metadata reads, and stdout processing.

Some none trials probed ancestor AGENTS, container root/home metadata, or whole-filesystem filenames; returned content was limited to the shared README, names/metadata and absence messages. No auxiliary document body read was observed.
Runtime model-catalog refresh timeout warnings concern Codex runtime metadata requests, not agent shell networking; all 324 trials completed successfully.
Nonzero shell exits include no-match searches, absent AGENTS paths and HEAD lookup in the empty repository; these are not failed model trials.
limitations: This is a complete review of logged agent commands and targeted scope-exception outputs, not packet capture or filesystem-diff proof.
No explicit content-mutating command was observed; incidental runtime, shell, cache or git metadata writes are outside this statement.
No agent network command does not imply network hard isolation: model service, installation and runtime metadata access remain possible.
Semantic review was performed by an AI agent, not a human security audit or adversarial sandbox certification.

limits: Counts are checks performed, not independent scientific samples.
Hashes bind local artifacts but do not prove reviewer independence or authenticity.
Command-log review is not packet capture or filesystem-diff proof.
Finite resource samples do not establish complete peaks or absence of OOM.
Semantic review covers only four positive fixed-gold omission trials, not all answer correctness.
